summaries: A Form 10-K Annual Report for Ascent Industries Co. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task: The document reports Consolidated Operating Income of $20.4 million for 2022 and $27.3 million for 2021. It does not contain the 2023 or 2024 Operating Profit figures required to calculate the percentage change specified in the task, limiting its direct utility for the requested calculation.

An SEC Form 10-K Annual Report for Ascent Industries Co. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Regarding the task, the Consolidated Statements of Income (Loss) report "Operating (loss) income from continuing operations" as a loss of $37.4 million for 2023, establishing the baseline figure required for the requested calculation. However, the document does not contain financial data for the fiscal year 2024, so it cannot provide the necessary second-year data to calculate the percentage change from 2023 to 2024.
